title: 2006 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 3
statement: A square and an equaliteral triangle together have the property that the area of each is the perimeter of the other. Find the square's area.

solutions.text:
Let \(s, t\) be the side lengths of the square and triangle, respectively. Then \(4 s=\frac{\sqrt{3} t^{2}}{4}\), and so

\[3 t=s^{2}=\left(\frac{\sqrt{3} t^{2}}{16}\right)^{2}=\frac{3 t^{4}}{2^{8}}\]

so that \(t^{3}=2^{8}\) and \(s^{2}=3 t=3 \sqrt[3]{2^{8}}=12 \sqrt[3]{4}\).
